highlights.title: Quick‑Pick Treatments
changes: Long-pressing the + button on the home screen now shows Quick‑Pick Treatments that suggest bolus and carb amounts.
You can pick a bolus amount, a carb amount, or both, then slide to confirm to enact the bolus and/or log the carbs.
If you have no carb history, carb suggestion buttons are not shown.
The app shows progress text while updating and displays clear alerts if carb logging or bolus enactment partially or完全y.
The old "Quick‑Pick Boluses" setting and labels are renamed to "Quick‑Pick Treatments" and existing user opt‑ins are 迁移.

sources.title: Evolve Quick-Pick Boluses into Quick-Pick Treatments

highlights.title: Fix IOB chart shading and show projected IOB decay
changes: IOB shading no longer floats above the COB area and now hugs the IOB line.
A dashed projected IOB-decay line and faint future shading are shown in the COB/IOB chart.
Stale or out-of-window IOB projections are not rendered.
Selection dots are aligned to the stepped COB/IOB lines when inspecting values.

sources.title: nightscout/Trio#1382: Fix IOB area stacking + plot projected IOB decay

highlights.title: Fix snoozed alert countdown on Home screen
changes: Snoozed alerts on the Home screen now show the correct remaining minutes.
The countdown is measured from the current time so it no longer uses an outdated timer.

sources.title: nightscout/Trio#1390: Fix Snoozed Alert Display on Home View

highlights.title: Target line spans full chart window
changes: Glucose target lines now extend across the full chart window.
Targets are repeated for every day shown instead of being limited to a fixed three-day span.
The target line no longer disappears when the chart history window grows.

Span glucose target profiles across full chart window

highlights.title: Clarify ISF/CR picker label in override edit
changes: The ISF/CR picker label in the override edit form now reads "Also Inversely Change".
The override edit UI displays the updated label when choosing ISF/CR options.

sources.title: nightscout/Trio#1391: Fix Override Edit ISF/CR Picker Label
Align ISF/CR picker label in override edit form

items.title: Chart info button restyled and moved up
changes: The chart’s info (glossary) button now matches the alarm bell visual style in the meal row.
The info button was nudged upward to avoid overlapping the chart’s x-axis labels.
The button’s behavior is unchanged and still opens the chart legend when tapped.

includedPullRequests.body:
**Iteration on Quick-Pick Boluses**

Adding the ability to log carbs based on frequently logged carb amounts, following the same logic as bolus amounts.

Notes:

1. Replaced the custom slider with the default slider that is also used by Omnipod and TAI
2. If there are no carbs in history, no carb buttons will be shown - respecting users who do not log carbs
3. Added "Updating IOB" "Updating COB" and "Updating COB and IOB" messages
4. Raising error messages if one or both actions fail
5. Adding a line of text to the (?) file pointing to the normal Treatments View if the user wants a recommendation or a calculation
6. Renamed all files, names, etc from QuickPickBolus to QuickPickTreatments (sorry for all the changes, but it's the only clean way to do this...)
7. Fixed the alignment issue with German translation of "U"

Needs testing and code review.

includedPullRequests.title: Fix IOB area stacking + plot projected IOB decay
includedPullRequests.body: ## Summary ### Fix: IOB shading rendered above the COB area **Reported on Discord:** IOB plot fill was drawn above the COB chart. **Reason:** The COB/IOB pane draws its marks with fixed styles and explicit series: identities (introduced with the home-refactor chart rework). Swift Charts stacks AreaMarks that share an x value by default, and series: does not opt out of stacking — so the IOB area was offset upward by the COB value whenever COB > 0, floating above the COB area instead of hugging the IOB line. Line marks never stack, which is why only the shading was wrong. Fixed by declaring stacking: .unstacked on both area marks. ### Feature: projected active insulin in the COB/IOB pane oref already computes a full IOB projection every loop cycle, up to 48 points at 5 minute cadence, 4 hours ahead (the same array whose activity values feed the glucose forecasting in determine basal). Trio already persists this to `monitor/iob.json` each loop cycle. This PR surfaces it: - `IOBService` (which already watches the iob file) exposes the array as `iobProjection` - `HomeStateModel` mirrors it alongside `currentIOB` - the COB/IOB pane draws it as a dashed line with a faint area from "now" into the future, anchored at the newest determination's `deliverAt` - Any stale projection (older than newest determination) renders nothing, and points beyond the chart window are dropped Tested in the simulator with CGM + pump sims: carbs on board plus SMB-driven IOB confirm the shading now stays inside the IOB line with COB present, and the dashed decay curve renders from the current-time marker to the chart edge. ### Screenshots |

includedPullRequests.title: Match Chart Glossary Button to Alarm Button Style in Meal Panel
includedPullRequests.body:
## Summary

The info button in the bottom-right of the main chart was styled independently of the alarm bell in the meal row directly below it, building on liquid-glass-esque material style. Especially on light mode this made it quite indistinguishable from the chart background. This PR aligns the glossary button to the bell button and moves it up slightly, to stay fully clear of char x-axis.

No behavior change. The button still toggles `state.isLegendPresented`.
